title: 细节与感受

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：I remember feeling [emotion] because [reason]. I remember thinking, "[direct thought]".
sentenceFrames.usage: 把听众拉进你的内心世界。直接引语（你当时脑子里想的那句话）比间接描述有力得多。
sentenceFrames.example: I remember feeling this wave of panic wash over me. I remember thinking, "This is it. I've really done it this time."
substitutions: 关于一个紧张的时刻：I remember feeling _____. I remember thinking, "_____."
关于一个惊喜的时刻：I remember feeling _____. I remember thinking, "_____."
关于一个骄傲的时刻：I remember feeling _____. I remember thinking, "_____."
你的真实经历：I remember feeling _____. I remember thinking, "_____."

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：The [sensory detail] that struck me was [specific observation].
sentenceFrames.usage: 用一个感官细节让场景立体起来——视觉、听觉、嗅觉、触觉。
sentenceFrames.example: The detail that struck me was how quiet the office was. No keyboards clicking, no phones ringing — just this eerie silence. You could hear someone coughing three floors away.
substitutions: 走进一个陌生的地方**：The thing that struck me was how _____.
见到一个很久没见的人**：The thing that struck me was how _____.
到一个新的城市**：The thing that struck me was the smell/sound/sight of _____.
你的经历：The thing that struck me was _____.

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：That's when I realized [insight or shift in understanding].
sentenceFrames.usage: 故事的"顿悟时刻"——一切从这里开始改变。
sentenceFrames.example: That's when I realized I wasn't nervous about speaking English — I was nervous about sounding stupid. And those are two completely different things.
substitutions: That's when I realized **this job wasn't for me.
That's when I realized **I had been worrying about the wrong thing all along.
That's when I realized **_____ wasn't the problem — _____ was the problem.
你的顿悟时刻：That's when I realized _____.
